column1: The Dynamic Aggregate Supply Curve To study the behavior of this economy in the short run, it is useful to analyze the model graphically. Because graphs have two axes, we need to focus on two variables. We will use output Yt and inflation pt as the variables on the two axes because these are the variables of central interest. As in the conventional AD –AS model, output will be on the horizontal axis.
